notes: Royal Society paper. Sections numbered 1-4 (H1), subsections lettered (a)-(d) (H2). Tables use dotted-line separators. Heavy Greek letter usage in equations and inline math. Two-column layout on page 1. Expected metric table rows: 34 data + 3*(header+separator) = 40.

Technical report (not journal paper). Only 3 section headings (Acknowledgements, Executive Summary, Principal findings). Pages 6-7 have 18 numbered CAS cost category descriptions that look like headings but are list items. Table 3 is large (34 rows). Expected metric table rows: 50 data + 3*(header+separator) = 56.

APS physics paper. Roman numeral sections (I-VI) at H1, letter subsections (A-C) at H2. Zero numbered display equations despite heavy physics content -- all math is inline. Single data table (Table I, 13 rows, 3 columns). 12 figures. Pages 24-28 are references. Expected metric table rows: 13 data + 1*(header+separator) = 15.

NeurIPS paper. 14 H1 (sections 1-6 + appendices A-H), 2 H2 (D.1, H.1), 7 H3 (paragraph headings in Sec 4-5). ~31 additional bold paragraph openers are NOT headings. pymupdf4llm's 68 comes from counting all bold text (paragraph openers + figure captions + table category separators). Tables 2-3 have internal category separator rows adding ~7 extra metric rows. Expected metric table rows: 34 data + 5*(header+separator) + ~7 separators = ~53.
